description:

### **Job Description**


**Job Description – Business Analyst (BI \& AI)**

 **1\. About the Role**

  

We are looking for a **Business Analyst – BI \& AI** who can bridge the gap between business requirements, product teams, technology teams, and data\-driven decision\-making.

  

The candidate should have strong analytical and documentation skills, with hands\-on exposure to **BI, AI, data visualization, and productivity tools**. The role will involve understanding business requirements, converting them into structured product requirements, preparing BRDs/FRDs/User Stories, analyzing business data, and coordinating with cross\-functional teams for successful implementation.

  

The ideal candidate should be comfortable working across **Product, Development, QA, UI/UX, Support, Sales, and Business teams**.

 **2\. Key Responsibilities**

 **Business Analysis \& Requirement Management**

  

* Understand business processes, user needs, and product requirements.
* Gather, analyze, and document functional and business requirements.
* Prepare and maintain:
* + Business Requirement Documents (BRD)
	+ Functional Requirement Documents (FRD)
	+ User Stories
	+ Acceptance Criteria
	+ Process Flows / Workflows
	+ Use Cases
	+ Functional Specifications
* Identify gaps, dependencies, assumptions, and potential edge cases in requirements.
* Convert business requirements into clear and implementation\-ready specifications.
* Participate in requirement discussions with internal and external stakeholders.

 **BI \& Data Analysis**

  

* Work with business data to identify trends, patterns, anomalies, and insights.
* Prepare dashboards, reports, and analytical views using BI tools.
* Understand data sources, data relationships, KPIs, and business metrics.
* Work with various databases to extract and validate data.
* Support creation of business dashboards and management reports.
* Analyze existing reports and recommend improvements based on business requirements.
* Validate data accuracy between source systems, reports, and dashboards.

 **AI \& Productivity Tools**

  

* Explore and utilize **AI tools** to improve requirement analysis, documentation, data analysis, reporting, and productivity.
* Use AI\-assisted tools for:
* + Requirement analysis
	+ User Story creation
	+ Documentation
	+ Data analysis
	+ Report/dashboard ideation
	+ Process optimization
* Stay updated with emerging **AI, BI, analytics, and automation tools**.
* Identify practical opportunities where AI can improve business processes and product capabilities.

 **Cross\-Functional Coordination**

  

* Coordinate effectively with Product, Development, QA, UI/UX, Sales, Support, and other departments.
* Act as a bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams.
* Clarify requirements and resolve functional ambiguities during development and testing.
* Participate in sprint planning, requirement walkthroughs, UAT, and product demonstrations.
* Track requirement changes and communicate their impact to relevant stakeholders.

 **Product \& Process Analysis**

  

* Study existing product workflows and identify improvement opportunities.
* Analyze business processes and suggest process optimization.
* Identify functional gaps and translate them into product enhancement requirements.
* Support product teams in defining new features and improving existing functionality.
* Ensure requirements are aligned with business objectives and end\-user expectations.

 **3\. Required Skills**

 **Must Have**

  

* 1\+ year of experience as a **Business Analyst / Product Analyst / Functional Analyst / BI Analyst**.
* Strong understanding of business analysis concepts and requirement gathering.
* Good knowledge of **BRD, FRD, User Stories, Acceptance Criteria, and process documentation**.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Good understanding of data and business reporting.
* Hands\-on exposure to at least one BI / visualization tool such as:
* + Power BI
	+ Tableau
	+ Similar BI platforms
* Basic to intermediate knowledge of **Databases**.
* Good understanding of databases and data structures.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Good proficiency in MS Excel / Google Sheets.
* Ability to work with cross\-functional teams.

 **Preferred**

  

* Exposure to **AI tools such as ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Gemini, Claude, Lovable, or similar tools**.
* Experience using AI for business analysis, documentation, data analysis, or productivity.
* Knowledge of APIs and system integrations.
* Good understanding of REST APIs and JSON.
* Understanding of Agile / Scrum methodology.
* Experience working with Gitlab or similar project management tools.
* Experience in enterprise software/product development.
* Basic understanding of UI/UX and application workflows.

 **4\. Key Competencies**

  

* Business \& Functional Analysis
* Analytical Thinking
* Data Interpretation
* BI \& Dashboard Development
* AI Tool Adoption
* Requirement Documentation
* Problem Solving
* Process Understanding
* Stakeholder Management
* Cross\-Functional Coordination
* Communication Skills
* Attention to Detail
* Product Thinking

 **5\. Educational Qualification**

  

* Bachelor's degree in **Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, Engineering, Data Analytics, or a related field**.
* Additional certification in **Business Analysis, BI, Data Analytics, or AI** will be an advantage.

 **6\. What We Expect From the Candidate**

  

The candidate should be able to independently take a requirement from:

 **Business Requirement Requirement Analysis BRD/FRD User Stories Development Clarification QA/UAT Support Business Validation**

  

At the same time, the candidate should be able to work with business data and BI tools to:

 **Data Analysis Insight Dashboard/Report Business Decision**

  

The ideal candidate is therefore not only a documentation\-focused BA, but someone who can **understand the business, analyze data, leverage AI tools, and work closely with technology teams to deliver practical product solutions.**

 **7\. Experience**

 **Preferred:** 1–3 years

  

Candidates with strong analytical skills, good BI/AI tool exposure, and excellent requirement/documentation capabilities may be considered even if their experience is slightly below the preferred range.

title: Senior Quality Assurance Analyst
description:
**About Dash Technologies**
===========================


Founded in 2010 and headquartered in Dublin, Ohio, USA, Dash Technologies Inc. is a healthcare\-focused technology company with a global delivery center in Ahmedabad, India. For more than 15 years, Dash has partnered with healthcare and MedTech organizations to design and engineer digital health solutions spanning Medical IoT, device and system integration, connected applications, artificial intelligence, machine learning, and data analytics. Dash combines strong engineering capabilities with practical execution to advance healthcare’s digital transformation and improve care delivery.**The Opportunity**
===================


Dash Technologies is seeking an experienced **Manual Software Tester / QA Engineer** to support software testing and quality assurance for a Medical Device Software product being built from scratch.
You will be responsible for developing and executing test cases, identifying and tracking defects, supporting verification and validation activities, and ensuring high\-quality software releases.
This is a **hands\-on individual contributor role** focused primarily on manual testing. Experience with test automation is desirable but **optional**.**What You’ll Do**
==================

**Manual Software Testing**
---------------------------

* Develop, review, and maintain test cases, test scenarios, test scripts, and test data.
* Execute functional, regression, integration, system, exploratory, and user acceptance testing.
* Analyze requirements and create comprehensive test scenarios covering positive, negative, boundary, and edge cases.
* Identify, document, and track software defects through resolution using bug\-tracking tools.
* Perform retesting and regression testing after defect fixes and software changes.
* Review test results and provide clear testing status and release\-readiness updates.
* Validate software functionality across different environments, configurations, and supported platforms.
* Participate in release testing and ensure identified issues are appropriately addressed before release.

**Requirements and Test Coverage**
----------------------------------

* Review business, functional, and technical requirements to ensure they are testable and clearly understood.
* Identify gaps, ambiguities, dependencies, and potential risks in requirements.
* Define acceptance criteria and contribute to backlog refinement.
* Maintain traceability between requirements, test cases, defects, and test results where required.
* Collaborate with product and engineering teams to clarify expected behavior and acceptance criteria.

**Quality Assurance**
---------------------

* Contribute to test planning and overall QA strategy for the product.
* Maintain organized and accurate testing documentation and records.
* Ensure testing activities are performed consistently across development cycles.
* Participate in defect triage, root cause discussions, and quality reviews.
* Communicate testing progress, risks, blockers, and quality concerns to relevant stakeholders.
* Support continuous improvement of testing processes and practices.

**Agile Testing**
-----------------

* Work closely with Agile development teams throughout the sprint lifecycle.
* Participate in sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand\-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
* Perform testing within development sprints rather than only at the end of the development cycle.
* Collaborate with developers to reproduce, investigate, and resolve defects.
* Ensure acceptance criteria are adequately covered before stories are considered complete.
* Support appropriate quality gates before software releases.

**Test Automation — Optional**
------------------------------

* Experience with test automation is an advantage but is **not mandatory**.
* Contribute to identifying suitable test cases for automation.
* Work with automation engineers or developers to improve automated test coverage.
* Basic experience with automation tools or frameworks such as Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, or similar is desirable.
* Familiarity with CI/CD\-based automated testing is a plus.

**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**
-----------------------------------

* Partner with product managers and business analysts to understand requirements and expected outcomes.
* Work closely with software developers to investigate and resolve defects.
* Collaborate with other QA team members to improve test coverage and testing practices.
* Communicate testing status, defects, risks, and blockers clearly to project stakeholders.
* Participate in product demonstrations and reviews to understand new functionality.

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Electronics, Biomedical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* **At least 3–5 years of experience in software testing or quality assurance.**
* Strong hands\-on experience in **manual software testing**.
* Experience developing and executing test cases, test scenarios, test scripts, and test plans.
* Experience performing functional, regression, integration, system, and exploratory testing.
* Strong understanding of software testing concepts and Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
* Experience identifying, documenting, and tracking defects using tools such as Jira or similar platforms.
* Experience working with Agile methodologies such as Scrum or Kanban.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to work independently.
* Experience with test management tools such as Jira, TestRail, Zephyr, QATouch, or similar platforms.

**Bonus Points**
================

* Experience testing **Medical Device Software, Healthcare Software, or MedTech products**.
* Experience working on products developed from scratch.
* Experience testing web applications, mobile applications, APIs, or integrated systems.
* Basic knowledge of API testing tools such as Postman or similar.
* Basic SQL/database testing experience.
* Experience with test automation tools such as Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, Appium, or similar.
* Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and automated test execution.
* Experience with performance, usability, compatibility, or security testing.
* Experience working in a startup or new product development environment.
* Experience with Medical IoT or connected healthcare applications.

**How You Work**
================

**Skills and Competencies**
---------------------------

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent attention to detail.
* Ability to think from an end\-user perspective and identify unexpected scenarios.
* Strong defect investigation and root cause analysis skills.
* Good understanding of risk\-based testing and test prioritization.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple testing activities.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills.
* Ability to work effectively with developers, product managers, business analysts, and other stakeholders.
* Strong ownership of assigned testing activities.
* Willingness to learn new technologies, tools, and testing techniques.

**Values We Seek**
==================

* **Quality Mindset:** Commitment to delivering reliable, high\-quality software.
* **Customer Focus:** Ability to understand software from the user's perspective.
* **Attention to Detail:** Thoroughness in identifying defects and validating functionality.
* **Collaboration:** Effective communication and teamwork across technical and non\-technical teams.
* **Continuous Improvement:** Interest in improving testing processes, coverage, and efficiency.

**Why Join Dash**
=================

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* A hands\-on QA role supporting a Medical Device Software product from the ground up.
* The opportunity to contribute to testing strategy and quality practices for a new product line.
* Exposure to Medical IoT, artificial intelligence, and digital health initiatives.
* A collaborative team at our Ahmedabad delivery center.
* Competitive compensation, performance\-based bonuses, and comprehensive benefits.
* Professional development support for training and industry certifications.
* Flexible work arrangements and a culture that values quality, innovation, and continuous improvement.

title: Senior Data Quality Assurance Specialist
description:
The Senior Data Quality Assurance (QA) Specialist is responsible for ensuring the accuracy, completeness, consistency, and reliability of enterprise data assets, reporting solutions, and data integration processes.

This role serves as the primary quality assurance resource for Power BI reporting, SQL\-based data warehouses, ETL processes, and data integrations from internal and third\-party systems.

The Senior Data QA Specialist will perform comprehensive validation of data pipelines, reports, dashboards, and database objects while proactively identifying and resolving data discrepancies across multiple systems.

The position works closely with Data Engineers, BI Developers, Business Analysts, and business stakeholders to ensure data integrity throughout the data lifecycle.

Additionally, this role supports production operations through troubleshooting, root cause analysis, defect management, and resolution of data\-related issues impacting business reporting and analytics.

This position will report to the Director — Enterprise Data and BI
